phases.name: Foundation
phases.exitGate: A clean checkout builds and tests, architecture boundaries are enforceable, and deterministic fixtures exist.

phases.name: Local-first graph core
phases.exitGate: Graphs can be created, edited through commands, saved offline, reopened, undone and redone, imported, and exported without a server.

phases.name: Editable workbench MVP
phases.exitGate: A user can open a workspace, create and connect typed nodes, edit properties, arrange the graph, save and reopen it, and operate the core editor by pointer or keyboard.

phases.name: JavaScript actions and optional integrations
phases.exitGate: A local worker action can be discovered, invoked, cancelled, validated, applied, and undone while remote integration remains optional.

phases.name: Investigation projections and dashboard
phases.exitGate: Graph, table, map, timeline, dashboard, editor, and document views coordinate through stable identifiers without creating duplicate canonical stores.

phases.name: Production deployment
phases.exitGate: The static PWA is reproducibly deployed, installable, offline-capable, secure under its CSP, accessible, performance-budgeted, recoverable, versioned, and rollback-ready.
